title_en: Wonders of Chinese Engineering (19/20): The Baihetan Hydropower Station
note_en: 仅次于 (jǐn cì yú) means "second only to," and what it is second to follows directly: 仅次于三峡大坝的中国第二大水电站 "China's second-largest hydropower station, after only the Three Gorges Dam." Notice the word order: the whole 仅次于… phrase comes before the noun it describes, linked by 的, whereas English tucks "second only to…" after the noun.
